name: mob-spawner-delay
comment: WP-1.8 TileEntityMobSpawner count-down: a mob spawner (52) at (3,61,3) on the stone platform, a player 16 blocks or nearer from t=0. Every tick TileEntityMobSpawner.updateEntity draws three World.rand floats (particle position) and counts delay down from 20; t=0..19 are exactly the 20 count-down updates, so no spawn attempt is made (the first is at t=20, tick/mob-spawner-spawn). rng_state every tick.
